speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Keep to the flags, Master Shakespeare. The kennel is running, and your shoes are not a boat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am behind you. The flags are as wet as the kennel.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The cloak is dragging, mistress. I have the hem.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The porch is dry if a man stands out of the drip. Good morning, Master Thwaite.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Good morning. You are early, which spares the glass. I have seven heads, and I mean to stop when the glass has turned once.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Seven I can carry home. I lost count last Sunday.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Last Sunday was last Sunday. Sit, Alse, and do not time the pot from the pew.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: First. Six days of work, and this one set by. Lent does not rub the week out.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The house already knows the six. We came through the wet for the seventh.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Second. Appetite. A man may want a thing and leave it sitting where it is.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can hear that one and still eat my dinner.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Third. The tongue. What you do not say at a door is sometimes the better half of the errand.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I keep my tongue for the loom. The shuttle does not answer. The parish does.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Fourth. The purse. Coin that can sit is not coin that must travel. I shall name nobody's money.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. I am not counting in a porch.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. I brought no book, and I will not open one on the flags.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Fifth. A road. A date that lives in the head has not hired a beast, and is not yet a journey.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I have not hired one.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Sixth. A letter. A page with no day on it has not yet left the house.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I cannot read the page, sir. I am not asking to.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You are not required to. It is still on the board.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Seventh. Enough. The glass has turned once. I said I would stop, and the parish may go home to its dinner.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Seven, and one turning. I will take that, Master Thwaite, and I will not ask you for an eighth on the cobbles.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A short morning is a kindness to a loom. I am for the close.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Seven heads. I am not adding the one I lost last week.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sir John has said his part of the service and no more. Leave him to it. The kennel is still running.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I have the cloak. The pot will have survived seven, if it has survived anything.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are done with heads. Dinner can be dinner.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: God keep you all. Seven was the promise. I have kept it this once.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Come, before the glass finds an eighth on its own.
